tables.name: postman_workspaces
tables.purpose: Top-level RequestLab tenant and organization boundary.

fields.name: user_id
fields.purpose: Supabase Auth UUID of the workspace owner.

relationships: Has many postman_workspace_members, postman_collections, postman_environments, and postman_workspace_invites.

tables.name: postman_workspace_members
tables.purpose: Accepted workspace collaborators and their workspace role.

fields.name: user_id
fields.purpose: Supabase Auth UUID of the member.

tables.name: postman_workspace_invites
tables.purpose: Pending, accepted, or declined workspace invitations.

fields.name: workspace_name
fields.purpose: Display snapshot of the target workspace name.

relationships: References the inviting Supabase Auth user.

tables.name: postman_collections
tables.purpose: Groups related executable API endpoints and stores collection documentation.
relationships: Has many postman_folders, postman_requests, and postman_environments.

tables.name: postman_folders
tables.purpose: Hierarchically organizes endpoints inside a collection.

fields.name: is_starred
fields.purpose: Pins the folder at its hierarchy level.

relationships: Optionally belongs to a parent postman_folders row.

tables.name: postman_requests
tables.purpose: Stores a validated, executable API request template and its endpoint documentation.

fields.name: url
fields.purpose: URL template containing optional environment placeholders.

fields.name: headers
fields.purpose: Header rows; values may be sensitive.

fields.name: body_raw
fields.purpose: Raw or JSON body template; may contain sensitive values.

fields.name: body_form
fields.purpose: Form body rows; values may be sensitive.

relationships: Optionally belongs to postman_folders in the same collection.

tables.name: postman_environments
tables.purpose: Stores collection-scoped variables resolved into request templates at execution time.

fields.name: name
fields.purpose: Environment display name such as User Acceptance Testing.

fields.name: variables
fields.purpose: Enabled/disabled key-value rows; values may contain secrets.

relationships: Belongs to postman_collections in the same workspace.
